name: Personal Data
description: Any information that is linked or reasonably linkable to an identified or identifiable natural person; does not include de-identified data or publicly available information.

name: Racial or Ethnic Origin
description: Personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin.

name: Mental or Physical Health Diagnosis
description: Personal data revealing mental or physical health diagnosis.

name: Citizenship or Immigration Status
description: Personal data revealing citizenship or immigration status.

name: Genetic or Biometric Data for Unique Identification
description: The processing of genetic or biometric data for the purpose of uniquely identifying a natural person.

name: Personal Data Collected from a Known Child
description: The personal data collected from a known child, meaning any natural person younger than 13 years of age.

name: Precise Geolocation Data
description: Information that directly identifies the specific location of a natural person with precision and accuracy within a radius of 1,750 feet.

name: De-identified Data
description: Data that cannot reasonably be linked to an identified or identifiable natural person, or a device linked to such person; excluded from personal data.

name: Pseudonymous Data
description: Personal data that cannot be attributed to a specific natural person without the use of additional information kept separately and subject to appropriate technical and organizational measures.

name: Publicly Available Information
description: Information lawfully made available through government records or that a business has a reasonable basis to believe is lawfully made available to the general public; excluded from personal data.
